구간은 1행부터 738행까지 빈틈없이 이어진다.

| 1–39 | 문서 머리·입력 형식 — 적조(Red Tide) Alexandrium fundyense 생물 모델의 입력 문서다(1). 주석은 키워드 순서, 대입 기호, 주석·빈 줄 처리, 연속 줄, 값 반복 및 중첩 격자(nested grid) 배열 순서를 설명한다(10–34). 주석은 단위를 대괄호로 표시하고 기본값을 중괄호로 표시한다고 명시한다(38–39). 원문: `! KEYWORD (usually, upper case) is typed correctly followed by "="  or "=="   !` (11); `! symbols. Any comment lines are allowed and must begin with an exclamation   !` (12); `! mark (!) in column one.  Comments may  appear to the right of a parameter   !` (13); `! specification to improve documentation.  Comments will be ignored  during   !` (14); `! reading.  Blank lines are also allowed and ignored. Continuation lines in   !` (15); `! a parameter specification are allowed and must be preceded by a backslash   !` (16); `! (\).  In some instances, more than one value is required for a parameter.   !` (17); `! If fewer values are provided, the  last value  is assigned for the entire   !` (18); `! parameter array.  The multiplication symbol (*),  without blank spaces in   !` (19); `! between, is allowed for a parameter specification.  For example, in a two   !` (20); `! grids nested application:                                                   !` (21); `!    AKT_BAK == 2*1.0d-6  2*5.0d-6              ! m2/s                        !` (23); `! indicates that the first two entries of array AKT_BAK,  in fortran column-  !` (25); `! major order, will have the same value of "1.0d-6" for grid 1,  whereas the  !` (26); `! next two entries will have the same value of "5.0d-6" for grid 2.           !` (27); `! In multiple levels of nesting and/or multiple connected domains  step-ups,  !` (29); `! "Ngrids" entries are expected for some of these parameters.  In such case,  !` (30); `! the order of the entries for a parameter is extremely important.  It  must  !` (31); `! follow the same order (1:Ngrids) as in the state variable declaration. The  !` (32); `! USER may follow the above guidelines for specifying his/her values.  These  !` (33); `! parameters are marked by "==" plural symbol after the KEYWORD.              !` (34); `! | 182–218 | 측면 경계 조건(lateral boundary condition) — 주석은 경계 배열 차원과 서·남·동·북 순서를 정의한다(182–187). 주석은 RadNud 복합 키워드와 단일 항목의 압축 입력을 설명한다(189–197). 목록의 ASCII 도식은 서쪽 1, 남쪽 2, 동쪽 3, 북쪽 4를 표시한다(201–215). 입력은 와편모조류의 경계 조건을 지정한다(217). 원문: `! | 299–312 | 생물 계산·반복 용어 설명 — 주석은 모든 격자에서 Lbiology의 기본값이 TRUE라고 적는다(299–302). 주석은 생물 계산을 선택할 때 NBT와 일관성을 유지해야 하며 메모리 효율을 위해 계산하지 않는 격자의 NBT를 0으로 두어야 한다고 적는다(303–307). 주석은 BioIter를 비선형 암시적(implicit) 해의 최대 반복 횟수로 정의한다(309–310). 원문: `!  Lbiology       Switch to control the computation of a particular module` (299); `!                   within nested and/or multiple connected grids. By default` (300); `!                   this switch is set to TRUE in "mod_scalars" for all grids.` (301); `!                   Ngrids values are expected. The USER has the option, for` (302); `!                   example, to compute the biology in just one of the nested` (303); `!                   grids. If so, this switch needs to be consistent with the` (304); `!                   dimension parameter NBT in "mod_param".  In order to make` (305); `!                   the model more efficient in memory usage, NBT(:) should` (306); `!                   be zero in such grids.` (307); `!  BioIter        Maximum number of iterations to achieve convergence of` (309); `!                   the nonlinear implicit solution.` (310). |
| 313–342 | 성장·발아·호흡·광 용어 설명 — 주석은 최대 성장률, 낭포(cyst)가 발아하여 대발생(bloom)에 기여할 수 있는 평균 퇴적층 깊이, 영양염 제한 성장의 반포화, 성장 효율 및 유지 호흡을 정의한다(313–324). 주석은 임계 수심 계산용 복사, 수주·퇴적층 광 감쇠와 밝은 조건·어두운 조건의 발아 조도를 단위와 함께 정의한다(327–341). 키워드 철자도 원문 그대로 인용한다(337). 원문: `!  Gmax           Maximum growth rate at optimal temperature and salinity` (313); `!                   (1/day)` (314); `!  Dg             Mean depth (cm) of sediment over which cysts are able to` (316); `!                   germinate and contribute to the bloom` (317); `!  Kn             Half-saturation constant for nutrient limited growth` (319); `!                   (millimoles/m3)` (320); `!  G_eff          Growth efficiency (m2/Watts/day)` (322); `!  G_r            Maintanenance respiration rate [1/day]` (324); `! srad_Cdepth     Averaged surface solar shortwave radiation used in the` (327); `!                   computation of critical depth in the growth function` (328); `!                   (Watts/m2)` (329); `!  AttW           Mean diffuse attenuation coefficient in the water column` (331); `!                   (1/m)` (332); `!  AttS           Mean diffuse attenuation coefficient in the sediment` (334); `!                   (1/mm)` (335); `!  E_ligth        Light level for germination under "light" conditions` (337); `!                   (Watt/m2)` (338); `!  E_dark         Light level for germination under dark conditions` (340); `!                   (watt/m2)` (341). |
| 343–358 | 성장 수온·DIN·수직 유영 용어 설명 — 주석은 성장 수온 인자를 3차 다항 적합으로 계산하고 더 낮은 수온에는 선형 외삽(linear extrapolation)을 사용한다고 적는다(343–347). 주석은 임계 수심 아래의 DIN 농도와 기본값을 제시한다(349–351). 주석은 수직 유영률과 상향 양수·하향 음수 규약을 명시한다(353–357). 원문: `! Linear extrapolation is used for colder temperatures.` (346); `!                   (Default = 5.0)` (347); `!  DIN_Cdepth     Constant Dissolved Inorganic Nutrient (DIN) concentration` (349); `!                   below of growth critical depth (millimoles/m3).` (350); `!                   (Default = 15.0)` (351); `!  wDino          Dinoflagellate (Alexandrium Fundyense) vertical swimming` (353); `!                   rate (positive; m/day). The convention in the vertical` (354); `!                   flux semi-Lagrangian algorithm is upward vertical motion` (355); `!                   (swimming, floating) is positive whereas downward vertical` (356); `!                   motion (sinking) is negative.` (357). |

The CPP option SPONGE is now deprecated and replaced with` (407); `!                   this switch to facilitate or not sponge areas over a` (408); `!                   particular nested grid; [1:NBT,1:Ngrids] values are` (409); `!                   expected.` (410); `! | 438–466 | Tracer advection scheme / 방법 목록 — 주석은 추적자별 스위치 설정의 이점을 설명한다(442–443). 주석은 양수인 염분·불활성·생물·퇴적물 필드에 양수 보장(positive-definite)·단조(monotonic) 방법이 유용하며 음수와 양수를 갖는 수온에는 다른 방법이 더 적절하다고 적는다(444–448). 목록은 이류 방법과 적용 방향을 제시한다(450–465). 원문: `! Tracer advection scheme.` (439); `! It is more advantageous to set the horizontal and vertical advection schemes` (442); `! for each tracer with switches instead of a single CPP flag for all of them.` (443); `! Positive-definite and monotonic algorithms (i.e., MPDATA and HSIMT) are` (444); `! appropriate and useful for positive fields like salinity, inert, biological,` (445); `! and sediment tracers.  However, since the temperature has a dynamic range` (446); `! with negative and positive values in the ocean, other advection schemes are` (447); `! more appropriate.` (448); `! Currently, the following tracer advection schemes are available and are` (450); `! activated using the associated Keyword:` (451); `!   Keyword    Advection Algorithm` (453); `!   A4         4th-order Akima (horizontal/vertical)` (455); `!   C2         2nd-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (456); `!   C4         4th-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (457); `!   HSIMT      3th-order HSIMT with TVD limiter (horizontal/vertical)` (458); `!   MPDATA     recursive flux corrected MPDATA (horizontal/vertical)` (459); `!   SPLINES    parabolic splines reconstruction (only vertical)` (460); `!   SU3        split third-order upstream (horizontal/vertical)` (461); `!   U3         3rd-order upstresm-bias (only horizontal)` (462); `! The user has the option of specifying the full Keyword or the first` (464); `! two letters, regardless if using uppercase or lowercase.` (465). |
| 467–486 | Tracer advection scheme / 단조성 조건·배열 — HSIMT 또는 MPDATA를 사용하면 단조성을 유지하기 위해 수평·수직에 같은 방법을 설정해야 한다(467–469). 주석은 비선형·수반 수평·수직 이류 스위치의 요구 배열 차원을 각각 제시한다(471–485). 원문: `! If using either HSIMT (Wu and Zhu, 2010) or MPDATA (Margolin and` (467); `! Smolarkiewicz, 1998) options, the user needs to set the same scheme` (468); `! for both horizontal and vertical advection to preserve monotonicity.` (469); `! Hadvection     Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (471); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (472); `!                  values are expected.` (473); `! Vadvection     Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (475); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (476); `!                  values are expected.` (477); `! ad_Hadvection  Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (479); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (480); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (481); `! ad_Vadvection  Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (483); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (484); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (485). |
| 487–524 | Tracer advection scheme / 입력 예제 — 예제는 추적자별 설정과 세 중첩 격자의 설정을 제시한다(487–513). 모든 수동 추적자(passive tracer)의 수평·수직 방법이 같을 때 압축 입력을 사용할 수 있다고 적는다(515–523). 연속 줄과 추적자·격자 주석을 원문 그대로 인용한다(489–520). 원문: `! Examples:` (487); `!  Hadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (489); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (490); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (491); `!                HSIMT                          ! dy2_02, inert(2)` (492); `!  Vadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (494); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (495); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (496); `!                HSIMT                          ! dye_02, inert(2)` (497); `! or in nested applications` (499); `!  Hadvection == U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (501); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (502); `! Vadvection == C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (508); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (509); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (510); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (511); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (512); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (513); `! It is convinient to use the compact specification format for biological and` (515); `! sediment passive tracers as:` (516); `!  Hadvection == HSIMT                          ! idbio(:), compact` (518); `!  Vadvection == HSIMT                          ! idbio(:), compact` (520); `! when all the passive tracers have the same horizontal and vertical tracer` (522); `! advection scheme.` (523). |
| 525–549 | Lateral boundary conditions parameters / 배열·복합 키워드 — 주석은 경계 조건을 CPP 플래그 대신 논리 스위치로 지정한다고 적는다(529–533). 주석은 배열의 경계 변·상태 변수·중첩 격자 차원을 설명한다(535–536). 예제는 네 방향의 gradient 구조체 항목과 RadNud 복합 키워드를 제시한다(537–548). 원문: `! Lateral boundary conditions parameters.` (526); `! The lateral boundary conditions are now specified with logical switches` (529); `! instead of CPP flags to allow nested grid configurations. Their values are` (530); `! load into structured array:` (531); `!    LBC(1:4, nLBCvar, Ngrids)` (533); `! where 1:4 are the number of boundary edges, nLBCvar are the number LBC state` (535); `! variables, and Ngrids is the number of nested grids. For Example, to apply` (536); `! gradient boundary conditions to any tracer we use:` (537); `!    LBC(iwest,  isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (539); `!    LBC(ieast,  isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (540); `!    LBC(isouth, isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (541); `!    LBC(inorth, isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (542); `! The lateral boundary conditions for biological tracers are entered with` (544); `! a keyword. This keyword is case insensitive and usually has three characters.` (545); `! However, it is possible to have compound keywords, if applicable. For example,` (546); `! the keyword "RadNud" implies radiation boundary condition with nudging. This` (547); `! combination is usually used in active/passive radiation conditions.` (548). |

Similarly, the adjoint-based algorithms (ADM, TLM, RPM) can have different` (581); `! lateral boundary conditions keywords:` (582); `!  ad_LBC(isTvar) Biological Tracers, [1:4, 1:NBT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (584). |

If you want to add other tracer variables` (620); `!                   (other than temperature and salinity) as a source for a` (621); `!                   particular river(s), you just need to specify such values` (622); `!                   on those river(s). Then, set the values to ZERO on the` (623); `!                   other river(s) that do NOT require such river forcing for` (624); `!                   that tracer. Logical switches for nudging to climatology: [1:NBT,1:Ngrids].` (645); `! These switches also control` (649); `!                   which biological tracer variables to nudge. The CPP option` (650); `!                   TCLM_NUDGING is now obsolete and replaced with these` (651); `!                   switches to facilitate nesting.` (652); `!                     LnudgeTCLM(idbio(1),ng)     Dinoflagellate concetration` (654); `!                   User also needs to TURN ON the respective logical switches` (656); `! This data can be set` (658); `!                   with analytical functions (ANA_TCLIMA) or read from input` (659); `!                   climatology NetCDF file(s).` (660); `!                   The nudging coefficients CLIMA(ng)%Tnudgcof can be set` (662); `!                   with analytical functions in "ana_nudgcoef.h"  using CPP` (663); `!                   option ANA_NUDGCOEF.  Otherwise, it will be read from` (664); `!                   NetCDF file NUDNAME.` (665). |

## 판독 중 확인된 사실 (판단 아님, 후속 검토 대상)

- 86·337: 밝은 조건의 발아 조도 입력 키워드는 `E_light`이다(86). 용어 설명의 키워드는 `E_ligth`이다(337).
- 112·120·363·372: 두 Q10 사망률 식은 배경 수온 이름을 각각 `MOR_To`와 `Mor_To`로 적는다(112·363). 입력과 용어 설명의 매개변수 이름은 숫자 0을 쓰는 `MOR_T0`이다(120·372).
- 133·409–410: LtracerSponge의 입력 주석은 요구 차원을 `[Ngrids]`로 적는다(133). 용어 설명은 `[1:NBT,1:Ngrids]`로 적는다(409–410).
- 492·497: 추적자별 이류 예제의 두 번째 불활성 추적자 주석은 수평 예제에서 `dy2_02`로 적는다(492). 수직 예제에서 `dye_02`로 적는다(497).
